<p class="owner"><span class="en">Author: Kai Marsh</span><span class="zh">作者：马凯</span></p>

::: {.en}
What an operating and maintenance (O&M) contract at a Victorian waste-to-energy plant would earn CDEG. The model starts from the running costs in [Model 1](wte-payback.qmd) (the WtE payback model) and chains four steps: **the plant's running costs** that an operator controls give a cost per tonne; **a margin** on top gives the O&M fee; **that fee times licensed tonnes** gives the size of the market; and **one contract's margin** against the entry budget gives CDEG's payback. CDEG has not yet given us its own operating cost, so the defaults are Model 1's benchmark settings. All money is A\$ at today's prices, excluding GST. The results bar at the bottom of the screen updates as you move any control.
:::

::: {.zh}
测算维州一座垃圾焚烧发电厂的委托运营（O&M）合同能为集团带来多少收益。模型以[模型1](wte-payback.qmd)（垃圾发电项目回收期模型）的运营成本为起点，分四步串联：运营方可控的**工厂运营成本**得出每吨成本；加上**利润率**得出运营费；**运营费乘以许可吨数**得出市场规模；**一份合同的利润**与进入预算相比得出集团的回收期。集团尚未提供自己的运营成本，因此默认值采用模型1的基准设定。所有金额为当前价格澳元，不含GST。屏幕底部的结果栏会随任何参数变化而实时更新。
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Use the locally bundled libraries instead of Observable's CDN defaults
Inputs = window.Inputs
Plot = window.Plot
d3 = window.d3
html = window.htl.html
// Label that switches with the language button (CSS shows one span)
L = (en, zh) => html`<span class="en">${en}</span><span class="zh">${zh}</span>`
lang = Generators.observe(notify => {
  const f = () => notify(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-lang") || "en");
  f();
  const mo = new MutationObserver(f);
  mo.observe(document.documentElement, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-lang"]});
  return () => mo.disconnect();
})
T = (en, zh) => lang === "zh" ? zh : en
C = ({base: "#2a78d6", low: "#eb6834", high: "#1baf7a", grey: "#9a9890", dark: "#0b0b0b"})
fmtM = v => (v / 1e6).toFixed(1)
kt = v => (v / 1e3).toFixed(0)
tile = (label, value, sub, warn) => html`<div class="kpi" style="${warn ? "border-color:#eb6834;background:#fdf1ec" : ""}"><div class="kpi-label">${label}</div><div class="kpi-value">${value}</div><div class="kpi-sub">${sub ?? ""}</div></div>`
// Victorian WtE licences, August 2025 (same figures as Model 1)
LIC = ({total: 2.35e6, cleanaway: 760e3, hiq: 750e3, mw: 450e3})
// Metro Vancouver contractor-run plant, C$93–112/t ≈ A$100–125/t, excluding ash and debt service
VANCOUVER = [100, 125]
```

## [1 · Running cost the operator controls]{.en}[1 · 运营方可控的运营成本]{.zh}

::: {.en}
The operator pays for staff, maintenance and consumables. We assume the owner pays for pre-sorting, ash disposal and reagents directly, so they are left out. Fixed costs are paid whatever the load, so the cost per tonne falls as availability rises.
:::

::: {.zh}
运营方承担人员、维护和耗材费用。假设预分拣、灰渣处置和药剂由业主直接支付，因此不计入。固定成本与负荷无关，因此可用率越高，每吨成本越低。
:::

:::: {.columns .model-row}
::: {.column width="40%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof furnaces = Inputs.range([1, 6], {value: 3, step: 1, label: L("Furnaces", "焚烧炉数量")})
viewof availability = Inputs.range([0.75, 0.95], {value: 0.9, step: 0.01, label: L("Availability", "可用率")})
viewof fixedFurnace = Inputs.range([2, 12], {value: 5, step: 0.5, label: L("Fixed cost per furnace (A$m/yr)", "单炉固定成本（百万澳元/年）")})
viewof varOpex = Inputs.range([10, 60], {value: 30, step: 5, label: L("Variable cost (A$/t burned)", "变动成本（澳元/吨）")})
```

<details><summary><span class="en">Plant size and site cost assumptions (same defaults as Model 1)</span><span class="zh">工厂规模与厂区成本假设（与模型1默认值相同）</span></summary>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof tpd = Inputs.range([300, 750], {value: 500, step: 50, label: L("Furnace size (t/day)", "单炉规模（吨/日）")})
viewof fixedSite = Inputs.range([0, 10], {value: 3, step: 0.5, label: L("Site overhead (A$m/yr)", "厂区管理费用（百万澳元/年）")})
```

</details>
:::

::: {.column width="60%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
costAt = (n, avail) => {
  const tonnes = n * tpd * 365 * avail;
  const fixed = (n * fixedFurnace + fixedSite) * 1e6;
  return {tonnes, fixed, fixedT: fixed / tonnes};
}
plant = costAt(furnaces, availability)
// Spares and consumables the owner may supply directly (section 2) come off the variable cost
costT = plant.fixedT + varOpex * (1 - ownerShare)
{
  const curve = d3.range(0.75, 0.951, 0.01).map(a => ({a, fixed: costAt(furnaces, a).fixedT, total: costAt(furnaces, a).fixedT + varOpex * (1 - ownerShare)}));
  return Plot.plot({
    height: 260, marginLeft: 50,
    x: {label: T("Availability", "可用率"), tickFormat: d => `${Math.round(d * 100)}%`},
    y: {label: T("A$ per tonne", "澳元/吨"), grid: true, domain: [0, d3.max(curve, d => d.total) * 1.1]},
    marks: [
      Plot.areaY(curve, {x: "a", y: "fixed", fill: C.base, fillOpacity: 0.2}),
      Plot.line(curve, {x: "a", y: "fixed", stroke: C.base, strokeWidth: 1.5}),
      Plot.line(curve, {x: "a", y: "total", stroke: C.dark, strokeWidth: 2.5}),
      Plot.dot([{a: availability, total: costT}], {x: "a", y: "total", r: 5, fill: C.dark}),
      Plot.text([curve[0]], {x: "a", y: "fixed", text: () => T("Fixed", "固定成本"), dy: 12, dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11, fill: "#1d5aa6"}),
      Plot.text([curve[0]], {x: "a", y: "total", text: () => T("Fixed + variable", "固定 + 变动"), dy: -8, dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11, fill: C.dark}),
      Plot.tip(curve, Plot.pointerX({x: "a", y: "total", title: d => `${T("Availability", "可用率")}: ${Math.round(d.a * 100)}%\n${T("Fixed", "固定成本")}: A$${d.fixed.toFixed(0)}/t\n${T("Operator total", "运营方合计")}: A$${d.total.toFixed(0)}/t`}))
    ]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="kpi-row">
  ${tile(T("Tonnes a year", "年处理量"), `${kt(plant.tonnes)} kt`, T(`${furnaces} × ${tpd} t/d × 365 × ${Math.round(availability * 100)}%`, `${furnaces} × ${tpd}吨/日 × 365 × ${Math.round(availability * 100)}%`))}
  ${tile(T("Fixed cost", "固定成本"), `A$${plant.fixedT.toFixed(0)}/t`, T(`A$${(plant.fixed / 1e6).toFixed(1)}m a year`, `每年${(plant.fixed / 1e6).toFixed(1)}百万澳元`))}
  ${tile(T("Variable cost", "变动成本"), `A$${(varOpex * (1 - ownerShare)).toFixed(0)}/t`, ownerShare > 0 ? T(`A$${varOpex}/t less ${Math.round(ownerShare * 100)}% paid by owner`, `${varOpex}澳元/吨，扣除业主承担的${Math.round(ownerShare * 100)}%`) : T("consumables and maintenance", "耗材与维护"))}
  ${tile(T("Operator-controlled cost", "运营方可控成本"), `A$${costT.toFixed(0)}/t`, T("before margin", "未计利润"))}
</div>`
```
:::
::::

## [2 · The O&M fee: cost plus margin]{.en}[2 · 运营费：成本加利润]{.zh}

::: {.en}
The operator's fee is its cost per tonne plus a margin. The chart sets the result against our A\$60–110/t range and against Metro Vancouver's contractor-run plant, which costs about C\$93–112/t (roughly A\$100–125/t) to operate, excluding ash and debt service \[74\]. Vancouver's is an older plant, so it sits at the top of our range.
:::

::: {.zh}
运营费等于运营方每吨成本加利润。图表将结果与我们的60–110澳元/吨区间以及温哥华都会区（Metro Vancouver）委托运营的焚烧厂对比：后者运营成本约93–112加元/吨（约100–125澳元/吨），不含灰渣处置和偿债 \[74\]。该厂较老，因此位于我们区间的上端。
:::

:::: {.columns .model-row}
::: {.column width="40%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof markup = Inputs.range([0, 0.3], {value: 0.125, step: 0.005, label: L("Operator margin on cost", "运营方成本加成率")})
viewof ownerShare = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0, step: 0.05, label: L("Share of spares and consumables the owner buys", "业主直接采购的备件与耗材比例")})
viewof roundFee = Inputs.toggle({value: true, label: L("Round the fee to the nearest A$5", "运营费取整至5澳元")})
```

<details><summary><span class="en">Benchmark range assumptions</span><span class="zh">基准区间假设</span></summary>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof rangeLow = Inputs.range([30, 90], {value: 60, step: 5, label: L("Low end of range (A$/t)", "区间下限（澳元/吨）")})
viewof rangeHigh = Inputs.range([80, 150], {value: 110, step: 5, label: L("High end of range (A$/t)", "区间上限（澳元/吨）")})
```

</details>
:::

::: {.column width="60%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
feeRaw = costT * (1 + markup)
fee = roundFee ? Math.round(feeRaw / 5) * 5 : feeRaw
profitT = fee - costT
// Margin as a share of revenue, the basis for CDEG's profit in section 4
netMargin = fee > 0 ? profitT / fee : 0
{
  const rows = [
    {k: T("Our range", "我方区间"), x1: rangeLow, x2: rangeHigh, c: C.grey},
    {k: T("Metro Vancouver", "温哥华都会区"), x1: VANCOUVER[0], x2: VANCOUVER[1], c: C.high}
  ];
  const ours = T("This model", "本模型");
  return Plot.plot({
    height: 170, marginLeft: 110,
    x: {label: T("A$ per tonne", "澳元/吨"), grid: true, domain: [0, Math.max(150, fee * 1.1)]},
    y: {label: null, domain: [ours, ...rows.map(d => d.k)]},
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(rows, {y: "k", x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: "c", fillOpacity: 0.5}),
      Plot.barX([{k: ours, x1: 0, x2: costT}], {y: "k", x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: C.base, fillOpacity: 0.35}),
      Plot.barX([{k: ours, x1: costT, x2: Math.max(fee, costT)}], {y: "k", x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: C.base}),
      Plot.text([{k: ours, x: Math.max(fee, costT)}], {y: "k", x: "x", text: () => `A$${fee.toFixed(0)}/t`, dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600}),
      Plot.tip([{k: ours}], Plot.pointerY({y: "k", x: () => fee, title: () => `${T("Cost", "成本")}: A$${costT.toFixed(1)}/t\n${T("Margin", "利润")}: A$${profitT.toFixed(1)}/t\n${T("Fee", "运营费")}: A$${fee.toFixed(1)}/t`}))
    ]
  });
}
```

<p class="figure-note"><span class="en">Light blue = operator cost; dark blue = margin.</span><span class="zh">浅蓝 = 运营方成本；深蓝 = 利润。</span></p>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="kpi-row">
  ${tile(T("O&M fee", "运营费"), `A$${fee.toFixed(0)}/t`, roundFee ? T(`A$${feeRaw.toFixed(1)}/t before rounding`, `取整前${feeRaw.toFixed(1)}澳元/吨`) : T("not rounded", "未取整"), fee < rangeLow || fee > rangeHigh)}
  ${tile(T("Margin per tonne", "每吨利润"), `A$${profitT.toFixed(1)}/t`, T(`${(netMargin * 100).toFixed(1)}% of the fee`, `占运营费${(netMargin * 100).toFixed(1)}%`), profitT <= 0)}
  ${tile(T("Against our range", "与我方区间对比"), fee < rangeLow ? T("Below", "低于") : fee > rangeHigh ? T("Above", "高于") : T("Inside", "区间内"), `A$${rangeLow}–${rangeHigh}/t`, fee < rangeLow || fee > rangeHigh)}
</div>`
```
:::
::::

## [3 · Market size: tonnes × fee]{.en}[3 · 市场规模：吨数 × 运营费]{.zh}

::: {.en}
Seven Victorian licences cover 2.35 Mt a year. Three large holders (Cleanaway 760 kt, HiQ 750 kt and Melbourne Water 450 kt) have not named an operator. HiQ's furnace vendor, Kanadevia Inova, can offer O&M with its grates, so it may never go to tender. Some owners will run their plants themselves.
:::

::: {.zh}
维州七张许可证合计每年235万吨。三家大型持证方（Cleanaway 76万吨、HiQ 75万吨、Melbourne Water 45万吨）尚未确定运营方。HiQ的炉排供应商Kanadevia Inova可随设备提供运营服务，因此HiQ可能不会招标。部分业主会自行运营电厂。
:::

:::: {.columns .model-row}
::: {.column width="40%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof dropHiQ = Inputs.toggle({value: true, label: L("Leave out HiQ (vendor likely to operate)", "剔除HiQ（供应商可能自行运营）")})
viewof selfOp = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0.5, step: 0.05, label: L("Share owners run themselves", "业主自行运营比例")})
```
:::

::: {.column width="60%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sam = LIC.cleanaway + LIC.hiq + LIC.mw
samAdj = dropHiQ ? sam - LIC.hiq : sam
reachable = samAdj * (1 - selfOp)
market = [
  {k: T("All licensed tonnes (TAM)", "全部许可吨数（TAM）"), t: LIC.total},
  {k: T("Cleanaway, HiQ and Melbourne Water (SAM)", "Cleanaway、HiQ和Melbourne Water（SAM）"), t: sam},
  ...(dropHiQ ? [{k: T("SAM without HiQ", "SAM（不含HiQ）"), t: samAdj}] : []),
  {k: T(`After ${Math.round(selfOp * 100)}% self-operate`, `扣除${Math.round(selfOp * 100)}%自行运营后`), t: reachable, sel: true}
].map(d => ({...d, v: d.t * fee}))
Plot.plot({
  height: 40 + market.length * 38, marginLeft: 250,
  x: {label: T("A$m a year", "百万澳元/年"), grid: true, transform: d => d / 1e6},
  y: {label: null, domain: market.map(d => d.k)},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(market, {y: "k", x: "v", fill: d => d.sel ? C.base : "#86b6ef"}),
    Plot.text(market, {y: "k", x: "v", text: d => `A$${(d.v / 1e6).toFixed(0)}m`, dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11}),
    Plot.tip(market, Plot.pointerY({y: "k", x: "v", title: d => `${d.k}\n${(d.t / 1e6).toFixed(2)} Mt × A$${fee.toFixed(0)}/t = A$${(d.v / 1e6).toFixed(0)}m`}))
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<table class="site-compare">
  <thead><tr><th>${T("Market", "市场")}</th><th class="num">${T("Tonnes a year", "年吨数")}</th><th class="num">${T("Value a year", "年价值")}</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>${market.map(d => html`<tr class=${d.sel ? "sel" : ""}><td>${d.k}</td><td class="num">${(d.t / 1e6).toFixed(2)} Mt</td><td class="num">A$${(d.v / 1e6).toFixed(0)}m</td></tr>`)}</tbody>
</table>`
```
:::
::::

## [4 · CDEG's profit and payback]{.en}[4 · 集团利润与回收期]{.zh}

::: {.en}
CDEG's profit on one contract is the margin per tonne times the contract's tonnes. The entry budget is A\$9.6m over 2027–29 (Table 15 in the go-to-market section). Payback counts years of O&M profit needed to repay it, which starts about 2030–31.
:::

::: {.zh}
集团在一份合同上的利润等于每吨利润乘以合同吨数。进入预算为2027–29年共960万澳元（进入市场章节表15）。回收期为收回该预算所需的运营利润年数，运营收入约从2030–31年开始。
:::

:::: {.columns .model-row}
::: {.column width="40%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof contract = Inputs.radio(["two", "mw", "plant"], {value: "two", label: L("Contract", "合同"),
  format: k => ({two: L("Two-line plant (2 furnaces)", "两条线电厂（2台炉）"), mw: L("Melbourne Water (450 kt)", "Melbourne Water（45万吨）"), plant: L("Plant set in section 1", "第1节设定的电厂")})[k]})
viewof budget = Inputs.range([3, 20], {value: 9.6, step: 0.1, label: L("Entry budget (A$m)", "进入预算（百万澳元）")})
viewof term = Inputs.range([5, 25], {value: 10, step: 1, label: L("Contract length (years)", "合同期限（年）")})
```

<details><summary><span class="en">Discounting assumption</span><span class="zh">折现假设</span></summary>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof discount = Inputs.range([0.04, 0.14], {value: 0.08, step: 0.005, label: L("Discount rate (real)", "折现率（实际）")})
```

</details>
:::

::: {.column width="60%"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
contractT = ({two: costAt(2, availability).tonnes, mw: LIC.mw, plant: plant.tonnes})[contract]
revenue = contractT * fee
profit = contractT * profitT
budgetA = budget * 1e6
payback = profit > 0 ? budgetA / profit : null
// Budget spent before the contract starts; profit from year 1 of the contract, discounted to its start
npv = d3.sum(d3.range(1, term + 1), y => profit / (1 + discount) ** y) - budgetA
cum = [{y: 0, c: -budgetA}, ...d3.range(1, term + 1).map(y => ({y, c: -budgetA + profit * y}))]
Plot.plot({
  height: 260, marginLeft: 50,
  x: {label: T("Contract year", "合同年份"), tickFormat: d => String(d)},
  y: {label: T("Cumulative A$m", "累计百万澳元"), grid: true, transform: d => d / 1e6},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#52514e"}),
    Plot.barY(cum, {x: "y", y: "c", fill: d => d.c >= 0 ? C.high : C.low, fillOpacity: 0.8}),
    Plot.tip(cum, Plot.pointerX({x: "y", y: "c", title: d => `${T("Year", "第")} ${d.y}${T("", "年")}\n${T("Cumulative", "累计")}: A$${fmtM(d.c)}m`}))
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="kpi-row">
  ${tile(T("Contract tonnes", "合同吨数"), `${kt(contractT)} kt`, contract === "two" ? T(`2 × ${tpd} t/d at ${Math.round(availability * 100)}%`, `2 × ${tpd}吨/日，可用率${Math.round(availability * 100)}%`) : contract === "mw" ? T("Melbourne Water licence", "Melbourne Water许可量") : T(`${furnaces} furnaces`, `${furnaces}台炉`))}
  ${tile(T("Contract revenue", "合同收入"), `A$${fmtM(revenue)}m`, T(`a year at A$${fee.toFixed(0)}/t`, `每年，按${fee.toFixed(0)}澳元/吨`))}
  ${tile(T("CDEG profit", "集团利润"), `A$${fmtM(profit)}m`, T(`a year, ${(netMargin * 100).toFixed(1)}% of revenue`, `每年，占收入${(netMargin * 100).toFixed(1)}%`), profit <= 0)}
  ${tile(T("Payback", "回收期"), payback ? `${payback.toFixed(1)} ${T("yrs", "年")}` : "—", T(`A$${budget.toFixed(1)}m entry budget`, `进入预算${budget.toFixed(1)}百万澳元`), !payback || payback > term)}
  ${tile(T("NPV over the contract", "合同期净现值"), `A$${fmtM(npv)}m`, T(`${term} years at ${(discount * 100).toFixed(1)}%, less budget`, `${term}年，折现率${(discount * 100).toFixed(1)}%，扣除预算`), npv < 0)}
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// NPV of the chosen contract across O&M fees; cost per tonne held at section 1's value
annuity = d3.sum(d3.range(1, term + 1), y => 1 / (1 + discount) ** y)
npvAt = f => (f - costT) * contractT * annuity - budgetA
breakEven = costT + budgetA / (contractT * annuity)
{
  const sens = d3.range(40, 141, 1).map(f => ({f, npv: npvAt(f)}));
  return Plot.plot({
    height: 260, marginLeft: 50,
    x: {label: T("O&M fee (A$/t)", "运营费（澳元/吨）"), grid: true},
    y: {label: T("NPV (A$m)", "净现值（百万澳元）"), grid: true, transform: d => d / 1e6},
    marks: [
      Plot.rectX([{x1: rangeLow, x2: rangeHigh}], {x1: "x1", x2: "x2", fill: C.grey, fillOpacity: 0.12}),
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#52514e"}),
      Plot.ruleX([breakEven], {stroke: C.low, strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
      Plot.line(sens, {x: "f", y: "npv", stroke: C.base, strokeWidth: 2.5}),
      Plot.dot([{f: fee, npv: npvAt(fee)}], {x: "f", y: "npv", r: 5, fill: C.dark}),
      Plot.text([{f: breakEven}], {x: "f", y: () => npvAt(140), text: () => T(`Break-even A$${breakEven.toFixed(0)}/t`, `盈亏平衡 ${breakEven.toFixed(0)}澳元/吨`), dx: -6, textAnchor: "end", fontSize: 11, fill: "#b4471b"}),
      Plot.tip(sens, Plot.pointerX({x: "f", y: "npv", title: d => `${T("O&M fee", "运营费")}: A$${d.f}/t\n${T("Margin", "利润")}: A$${(d.f - costT).toFixed(1)}/t\nNPV: A$${fmtM(d.npv)}m`}))
    ]
  });
}
```

<p class="figure-note"><span class="en">NPV of the selected contract over its length, less the entry budget, at each O&M fee. Dot = current fee; dashed line = fee at which NPV is zero; grey band = our A$60–110/t range.</span><span class="zh">所选合同在合同期内的净现值（扣除进入预算）随运营费的变化。圆点 = 当前运营费；虚线 = 净现值为零时的运营费；灰色带 = 我方60–110澳元/吨区间。</span></p>
:::

## [Method and limits]{.en}[方法与局限]{.zh}

::: {.en}
- **Operator-controlled cost** = (fixed cost per furnace × furnaces + site overhead) ÷ tonnes a year + variable cost. Tonnes a year = furnaces × furnace size × 365 × availability. At the defaults (3 × 500 t/d at 90%), fixed costs of A\$18m a year over 492,750 t are about A\$37/t, plus A\$30/t variable, about A\$67/t in all \[26\].
- **Left out**: pre-sorting (A\$15/t in Model 1), ash disposal and reagents, which we assume the owner pays directly.
- **O&M fee** = operator cost × (1 + margin), rounded to the nearest A\$5 by default. A 10–15% margin gives about A\$74–77/t; the default 12.5% rounds to A\$75/t \[Assumption\].
- **Benchmark**: Metro Vancouver's contractor-run plant costs about C\$93–112/t (roughly A\$100–125/t) to operate, excluding ash and debt service \[74\] \[Industry\]. It is an older plant, so we put it at the top of our A\$60–110/t range.
- **Market sizes** use the August 2025 licences (2.35 Mt in all) and the one fee per tonne from section 2 for every plant.
- **Contracts** also use that one cost and fee per tonne, from the plant in section 1. A two-line plant or Melbourne Water's plant would have a somewhat different cost per tonne, because fixed costs spread over fewer tonnes.
- **Payback** = entry budget ÷ annual profit, with no discounting, counted from the first contract year (about 2030–31). **NPV** discounts the contract's profit to its start and subtracts the budget there; it ignores that the budget is spent two to three years earlier. The 10-year contract length and 8% discount rate are our assumptions. The NPV-vs-fee chart holds the operator's cost per tonne fixed and changes only the fee.
- **Not modelled**: availability bonuses and penalties, liability under guarantees, performance bonds, plant-crew mobilisation (usually paid by the owner [to verify]{.verify}), tax, and inflation.

**What would change these numbers.** The A\$5m per furnace and A\$30/t inputs are benchmark settings in Model 1, not quotes from operators. The 10–15% margin is an assumption. A\$75/t is a whole-plant running cost: the operator's fee alone could be lower if the owner pays for spares and consumables directly (the owner-share slider in section 2 tests this). CDEG's real operating cost per tonne should replace these defaults [to verify]{.verify}.
:::

::: {.zh}
- **运营方可控成本** =（单炉固定成本 × 炉数 + 厂区管理费用）÷ 年处理量 + 变动成本。年处理量 = 炉数 × 单炉规模 × 365 × 可用率。按默认值（3台500吨/日、可用率90%），每年1,800万澳元固定成本分摊到492,750吨，约37澳元/吨，加上30澳元/吨变动成本，合计约67澳元/吨 \[26\]。
- **不计入**：预分拣（模型1中为15澳元/吨）、灰渣处置和药剂，假设由业主直接支付。
- **运营费** = 运营方成本 ×（1 + 利润率），默认取整至5澳元。10–15%的利润率对应约74–77澳元/吨；默认12.5%取整为75澳元/吨 \[假设\]。
- **基准**：温哥华都会区委托运营的焚烧厂运营成本约93–112加元/吨（约100–125澳元/吨），不含灰渣处置和偿债 \[74\] \[行业\]。该厂较老，因此位于我们60–110澳元/吨区间的上端。
- **市场规模**采用2025年8月的许可量（合计235万吨），所有电厂均采用第2节的同一每吨运营费。
- **合同**同样采用第1节电厂的每吨成本和运营费。两条线电厂或Melbourne Water电厂的每吨成本会略有不同，因为固定成本分摊到的吨数较少。
- **回收期** = 进入预算 ÷ 年利润，不折现，自合同第一年（约2030–31年）起算。**净现值**将合同利润折现至合同开始时，并在该时点扣除预算；未考虑预算实际上提前两到三年支出。10年合同期限和8%折现率为我们的假设。净现值–运营费图保持运营方每吨成本不变，仅改变运营费。
- **未建模**：可用率奖惩、担保责任、履约保函、电厂运营团队进场费用（通常由业主承担 [待核实]{.verify}）、税费和通胀。

**哪些因素会改变结果。** 单炉500万澳元和30澳元/吨是模型1的基准设定，而非运营商报价。10–15%的利润率为假设。75澳元/吨是全厂运营成本：如果业主直接支付备件和耗材，运营方的服务费本身可能更低（可用第2节的业主采购比例滑块测试）。应以集团实际的每吨运营成本替换这些默认值 [待核实]{.verify}。
:::
